system.description: Requires human sacrifice and a massive Aeolian harp of taut cords plus five precisely tuned pipes. Base area: two-mile radius; each additional participant doubles the radius. Preparation takes five hours, then one human sacrifice per hour. In the first hour cold and clouds spread; the storm grows each subsequent hour. After eight hours the blizzard reaches maximum size and can be maintained four more hours before dissipating. A small area around the participants remains free of snow.
